items.source: Returns the default AccessOptions.GetOptions rejecting intermediate null values when accessing property paths.
items.translation: 返回默认AccessOptions.GetOptions，在访问属性路径时拒绝中间的空值。

items.source: Returns the default AccessOptions.SetOptions rejecting setting values when finding an intermediate property value to be null.
items.translation: 返回默认AccessOptions.SetOptions，该选项在查找中间属性值时若结果为 null，则拒绝设置值。

items.source: Access options when using PersistentPropertyPathAccessor to get and set properties. Allows defining how to handle null values, register custom transforming handlers when accessing collections and maps and propagation settings for how to handle intermediate collection and map values when setting values.
items.translation: 使用 PersistentPropertyPathAccessor 获取和设置属性时的访问选项。允许定义如何处理空值、在访问集合和映射时注册自定义转换处理器，以及设置传播配置以处理设置值时的中间集合和映射值。

items.source: Access options for getting values for property paths.
items.translation: 获取属性路径值的访问选项。

items.source: Access options for setting values for property paths.
items.translation: 设置属性路径值的访问选项。
